reason: ₹999 a month is not the issue for a salon my size, but half my staff will not work in an English app, and my whole business already runs fine on WhatsApp. If my stylists fumble at the counter, I end up back on WhatsApp and the register anyway.
objection: It is only in English. My staff and many of my customers want Hindi, and I am not going to make eight people learn a new English app at my age.
would_change_my_mind: A full Hindi version, for the app and the WhatsApp bills and reminders, with someone showing my staff how it works and then two weeks of it running properly in my salon.
